headline: Ripple won final approval for its US trust bank and signed stablecoin deals with Robinhood and BNY, bitcoin is holding just under $80,000 before Wednesday's Fed decision, and Robinhood reports after today's US close.

stories.title: Ripple gets its US trust bank and new stablecoin deals with Robinhood and BNY
stories.summary: The OCC, the US regulator for national banks, gave Ripple final approval for Ripple National Trust Bank, which will look after the reserves behind its RLUSD stablecoin. On Tuesday Ripple also announced a partnership with Robinhood, and BNY said its custody platform now holds XRP and RLUSD. A trust bank cannot take deposits or make loans.
points: Final approval follows conditional approval on 12 Dec 2025; the bank will manage RLUSD reserves and offer custody, but cannot take deposits, make loans or offer FDIC-insured accounts, and has no opening date yet, per The Crypto Times.
RLUSD's market value is about $2.5B, per The Crypto Times.
RLUSD is already on Robinhood Chain and Bitstamp by Robinhood and is planned for the Robinhood app later this year; Robinhood will also use Ripple Treasury, per KuCoin's report of the announcement.
BNY, which has $63.4T in assets under custody or administration, now supports XRP and RLUSD in custody; direct RLUSD minting and redemption are still planned, per Mugglehead.

stories.title: Bitcoin holds just under $80,000 as the Fed meets and US consumer confidence jumps
stories.summary: Bitcoin is sitting just below $80,000 on day one of the Fed's two-day meeting; the decision comes Wednesday afternoon US time and a hold is widely expected. A US consumer confidence reading this morning came in far above forecasts. A large batch of bitcoin options expires on Friday.
points: Bitcoin dropped below $80,000 as the Fed meeting began, and the most-traded option was a bet on a fall to $72,000 by 25 Dec, per CoinDesk.
The Conference Board's consumer confidence index rose to 91.7 in October from a revised 84.2, per the Conference Board; the consensus was 80.5, per Investing.com.
US spot bitcoin ETFs took in a net $110.3M on Monday 26 Oct, all into BlackRock's IBIT, after outflows of $635.5M on 22 Oct and $137.9M on 23 Oct, per TFTC.

Estimates for Friday's Deribit bitcoin options expiry differ: about $10.9B with 'max pain' at $78,000 (Bitcoin News Digest, 27 Oct) or $12.2B with max pain at $79,000 (CryptoTicker, as of 17 Oct). Max pain is not a price target.

stories.title: Crypto earnings week: Robinhood tonight, Coinbase on Thursday
stories.summary: Robinhood reports after today's US close. Galaxy already reported a $323M quarterly profit this morning, and Coinbase reports on Thursday. These results show how active everyday crypto traders were from July to September.
points: Robinhood reports after the close today with a call at 5:00pm ET (04:00 Wed Bangkok), per Robinhood.
Analysts expect Robinhood earnings of $0.56 a share on $1.44B of revenue, per TipRanks.
Galaxy reported net income of $323M for the third quarter, against an $85M loss in the second quarter, per its results release.
Coinbase reports after the close on Thursday 29 Oct, with a Q&A at 5:00pm ET (04:00 Fri Bangkok), per Coinbase.

briefs.title: Keystone will destroy almost 19,000 wallets after a breach
briefs.summary: Hardware wallet maker Keystone will destroy 18,835 unsold devices after its device signing key was stolen; 25,964 buyer records were exposed, but no seed phrases. Beware fake 'recall' messages, per CoinDesk.

briefs.title: Strategy bought no bitcoin last week
briefs.summary: Strategy bought no bitcoin from 19 to 25 Oct and spent $204.9M buying back its STRC preferred shares; it holds 848,517 BTC, per its SEC filing.

briefs.title: CFTC moves ahead on a registration path for crypto exchanges
briefs.summary: CFTC Chair Michael Selig said exchanges offering leveraged retail products or perpetual futures would have to register; comments are due 14 Dec, per CoinInsider.

briefs.title: Crypto groups have spent about $176M on the midterms
briefs.summary: Crypto groups have spent about $176M across more than 100 congressional races before the 3 Nov elections, about $150.8M of it from Fairshake and its affiliates, per crypto.news.

briefs.title: Canada drafts stablecoin rules and keeps the ban on interest
briefs.summary: Canada released draft stablecoin rules that ban paying interest, require 1:1 reserves and redemption within 3 business days; consultation runs to 23 Dec, per KuCoin's daily report.

briefs.title: October is DeFi's costliest month for hacks this year
briefs.summary: October DeFi losses reached about $718M across 11 exploits, the costliest month so far this year, per Chainalysis figures reported by Startup Fortune.

briefs.title: NBA signs on to CFTC prediction markets
briefs.summary: The NBA signed prediction-market deals with Kalshi and Polymarket and an agreement with the CFTC, per KuCoin's daily report.

Range 3.75-4.00%; a hold is expected (CME FedWatch 90.6% on 26 Oct, per Kiplinger; 94 of 100 economists in a Reuters poll, per Newsquawk). Chair Warsh's press conference 2:30pm ET (01:30 Bangkok).

Both report after the US close. Coinbase consensus EPS -$0.23, revenue $1.21B (MarketBeat). Token unlocks the same day: FF ~$19.5M and CARDS ~$19.1M, per the unlock data on this page.

At 08:00 UTC. About $10.9B with max pain at $78,000 (Bitcoin News Digest, 27 Oct) or $12.2B with max pain at $79,000 (CryptoTicker, as of 17 Oct). Max pain is not a price target. The Bank of Japan is expected to hold at 1.25% (Bloomberg survey via investingLive); its time is not fixed.
